answer: A new identity must post the same bond, so spinning up N fakes costs N times the stake, making the delta between honest and attacker cost steep. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted whisper quorum: each agent locks a bond, and votes carry weight proportional to bonded stake. Quorum signals propagate through the nebula mesh, where peers attest only to bonded agents, so cheap identities gain no traction. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
